whatIs.title: What is the EB-2 NIW Visa?
paragraphs: The EB-2 NIW is an employment-based immigration category that can lead to a Green Card in the USA.
The key feature of the National Interest Waiver is the possibility of requesting a waiver of the job offer and labor certification requirements when the specific requirements of the category are met.
This means that professionals may build a case based on their education, experience, professional background, and the relevance of their work to the interests of the USA.
whatIs.imageAlt: Smiling professional in an office overlooking city buildings

whoCan.title: Who may consider the EB-2 NIW?
whoCan.lede: This pathway may be relevant for professionals with:
items: A qualifying academic background or professional qualifications;
Significant professional experience and a well-established career;
Achievements and recognition in their field;
Work or a project with potential relevance to the USA;
A professional background that can be supported by documented evidence.

requirements.title: What are the EB-2 NIW requirements?
requirements.lede: To apply, the professional must first meet the requirements of the EB-2 category through one of the qualifications below:
requirements.imageAlt: Graduates in gowns holding diplomas at a graduation ceremony

routes.title: Advanced Degree
items: A master’s or doctoral degree in the field of expertise; or
A bachelor’s degree + at least 5 years of progressive experience in the field.

routes.title: Exceptional Ability
items: Professionals with experience, education, and recognition demonstrating knowledge significantly above that ordinarily encountered in the field;
Technical professionals with more than 10 years of experience in the field, along with other evidence that may demonstrate exceptional ability.

requirements.closing: In addition, the NIW petition considers factors such as the relevance of the proposed work to the United States and the professional’s ability to advance that work, among other criteria.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About the EB-2 NIW Visa

items.a: The EB-2 NIW is an employment-based immigration category that allows applicants to request a waiver of the job offer and labor certification requirements based on the national interest of the United States.

items.q: Does the EB-2 NIW give you a Green Card?
items.a: The EB-2 NIW is an immigration category that can lead to permanent residence. However, approval is not automatic and depends on meeting the applicable requirements and the review of the petition by the relevant U.S. authorities.

items.q: Do I need a job offer to apply for the EB-2 NIW?
items.a: The NIW allows applicants to request a waiver of the job offer and labor certification requirements when the applicable criteria are met.

items.q: Can I apply for the EB-2 NIW without a sponsoring employer?
items.a: Yes. The EB-2 NIW can be filed through self-petition, provided that the applicant demonstrates that their work can have an impact in the United States, among other criteria.

items.q: Do I need a master's degree to apply for the EB-2 NIW?
items.a: Not necessarily. The EB-2 category also includes the possibility of qualifying based on exceptional ability, in addition to the requirements related to an advanced degree.

items.q: Can any professional apply for the EB-2 NIW?
items.a: No. Applicants must meet the requirements of the category and demonstrate the elements required for the National Interest Waiver. This is why an individual profile assessment is important.

items.q: How long does the EB-2 NIW process take?
items.a: Processing times may vary depending on several factors, including processing times at U.S. government agencies and the specific circumstances of each case. Official processing times may change over time.
